verdict.rationale: Linear evidences a functioning app ecosystem — an 'integration directory' for third-party apps (linear-docs-65), admin approval workflows for third-party app installs (linear-docs-73), and OAuth app creation tooling (linear-docs-18, linear-docs-42) — plus specific named integrations (GitHub, Slack, Okta, GitHub Copilot). However, no evidence quantifies the marketplace scale as 'thousands of tools' or shows a browsable catalog UI. Missing for 10: quantified marketplace size/catalog listing, independent confirmation of breadth, and any hands-on account of browsing/installing from the directory.
